assembly_notes: Five independent component slots give 432 complete structural combinations, times five drawer-count values for the raw domain. One fixed root part `desk_carcass` carries the worktop slab, the grounded storage volumes, the plinths, every runner channel, every closure track and every hinge knuckle. Moving parts are N hollow drawer trays (prismatic, axis (0,-1,0), lower=closed), 1/2/4 closure leaves (revolute vertical hinge, revolute horizontal drop-front hinge, prismatic bypass sliders, or a prismatic slat curtain) and at most one secondary mechanism (prismatic keyboard tray or revolute cable hatch). Host adaptation: the worktop footprint derives 0/1/2 return underlayers plus the matching grounded return-end panels; the carcass family derives the closure opening width/height and count, the drawer opening width and the interior depth; the closure candidate derives its own leaf count, groove pitch, fascia split and hinge setback from that opening; N re-derives front height, level pitch, N-1 dividers, N bumpers and 2N runner channels; a keyboard tray without a knee bay reserves a zone that shortens the drawer bay. All clearances are real geometry, so no overlap allowance is emitted.
